summary: Four strong-value, active used‑SUV listings matching your criteria (2020 or newer, under ~40 k miles) in the Philadelphia region. Standouts include a low‑mileage 2026 Honda CR‑V EX‑L AWD, a well‑priced 2026 Subaru Forester Premium AWD CPO, plus another 2026 Honda CR‑V EX‑L AWD and a 2026 Subaru Forester Touring AWD. All are highly reliable; confirm total out‑the‑door pricing and vehicle history.

trimComparisons.model: Honda CR‑V EX‑L AWD vs Subaru Forester Premium AWD
trimComparisons.comparison: Both trims offer strong safety and comfort; Honda CR‑V EX‑L adds heated seats, moonroof, Apple CarPlay/Android Auto, Blind Spot Monitoring, and higher highway mpg (~31 hwy). Subaru Forester Premium CPO likely includes heated seats and possibly navigation, but tends to have slightly lower highway mpg (~32 hwy vs CR‑V’s 31). CR‑V may offer better technology package; Forester offers Subaru’s EyeSight safety system and all‑around visibility.
